name: InitObjectBuiltinTable
evidence: entry 12 of the startup table D_002647C0: calls func_00109488, which fills the table D_002505D8 with the object built-ins (TestScriptObjectOfKind, func_00100218, ...)

name: CreateTypedRecord
evidence: allocates a record of the size in D_00247448[type], links it into the type's list at +0x1884 + type * 4 of its context and runs the type's initialiser

name: ApplyPropertyRecord
evidence: reads one value from the stream per the record's type and flags and stores it to a field at an offset, passes it to a setter at a table slot or a given function, or calls a multi-value setter with an array of script values

name: ReadPropertyRecords
evidence: reads indices from the stream while they are not negative and applies each to the record D_002505D8 + (index << 5) with ApplyPropertyRecord

name: MapKeyToSlotIndex
evidence: subtracts 12 from the key and gives -1 unless the result is 0..30

name: ReadSlotObjects
evidence: reads a count of (type, key, flag) entries, makes each object with CreateTypedRecord, runs its slot 14 on the stream and files it in slot1CE8 at MapKeyToSlotIndex(key) when that is valid

name: ApplyObjectClassDefaults
evidence: slot 1: walks the entries of D_00244950 for the object's class id and, for each whose flags have 0x800, parses its body into a buffer and hands it to func_0011E680 with the object

name: FindCurveSegment
evidence: binary-searches the key times (a float at the start of each stride-byte record) for the segment holding the key, steps back one when exactly on a key if bit 0 of flags is set, and gives the offset in the segment, the segment length and the record pointer

name: EvaluateNoPositionCurve
evidence: empty; slot 10 of D_00219600, the position-curve slot whose times slot (12) is GetNoPositionCurveTimes

name: GetNoPositionCurveTimes
evidence: slot 2 of the empty position curve: sets the count to 0 and the times pointer to 0

name: EvaluateNoRotationCurve
evidence: empty; slot 14 of D_00219600, before GetNoRotationCurve, the rotation-curve slots whose times slot (17) is GetNoRotationCurveTimes

name: GetNoRotationCurve
evidence: empty; slot 15 of D_00219600 and slot 1 of D_00219708, where the keyed rotation curves have GetAxisRotationCurve and GetKeyedRotationCurve

name: GetNoRotationCurveTimes
evidence: sets the count to 0 and the times pointer to 0 for the empty rotation curve

name: EvaluateNoScaleCurve
evidence: empty; slot 18 of D_00219600, the scale-curve slot whose times slot (20) is GetNoScaleCurveTimes

name: GetNoScaleCurveTimes
evidence: sets the count to 0 and the times pointer to 0 for the empty scale curve

name: EvaluateNoWeightCurve
evidence: empty; slot 22 of D_00219600, the weight-curve slot whose times slot (24) is GetNoWeightCurveTimes

name: GetNoWeightCurveTimes
evidence: sets the count to 0 and the times pointer to 0 for a blended weight curve

name: ReadTangentWeightCurve
evidence: reads count and keys (time, value, two kind words and two tangent floats) from the stream into 0x18-byte keys

name: EvaluateTangentWeightCurve
evidence: finds the segment of the kind 0 keys and returns the key's constant value when its kind is 5, else interpolates with func_001303F0 from the two values and tangents

name: GetTangentWeightCurveTimes
evidence: gives the key count and, if asked, a new array of the keys' times

name: ReadControlPointWeightCurve
evidence: reads count and keys from the stream, turning two of the read values into control points value-t and value+u around the key value

name: EvaluateControlPointWeightCurve
evidence: finds the segment of the kind 1 keys and returns the constant value for kind 5, else interpolates with func_00130168 from values and control points

name: GetControlPointWeightCurveTimes
evidence: gives the key count and, if asked, a new array of the keys' times

name: EvaluateLinearWeightCurve
evidence: finds the segment of the kind 2 keys and returns the linear blend of the two values with its slope (zero for a segment shorter than 0.0001)

name: ReadLinearWeightCurve
evidence: reads count and (time, value) keys of 8 bytes from the stream, scaling the times by 1/60

name: GetLinearWeightCurveTimes
evidence: gives the key count and, if asked, a new array of the keys' times

name: EvaluateAxisCurves
evidence: original assembly: copies the base vector into the output and clears the slope, then for each of the three axis weight curves present calls its evaluate slot into that component; EvaluateAxisPositionCurve, EvaluateAxisRotationCurve, GetAxisRotationCurve and EvaluateAxisScaleCurve call it

name: ReadAxisCurves
evidence: reads a presence mask and a base vector, then for each set bit makes a weight curve with func_00121160 and reads it from the stream into the axis slot

name: GatherAxisCurveTimes
evidence: asks each of three weight curves for its key times, joins them, sorts with func_001F5CD0 and drops repeated times

name: EvaluateVectorKeyCurve
evidence: finds the segment among 0x40-byte vector keys with FindCurveSegment and interpolates their vectors with func_00130540

name: ReadVectorKeys
evidence: reads a count and, per key, a time (scaled by 1/60) and three vectors into 0x40-byte keys

name: GetVectorKeyTimes
evidence: gives the count and, if asked, a new array of the keys' times (stride 0x40)

name: EvaluateAxisPositionCurve
evidence: evaluates the three axis curves around the base vector with func_0011F6B0, then tells the owner's slot 44

name: ReadAxisPositionCurve
evidence: original assembly; slot 1 of D_002196B8 between EvaluateAxisPositionCurve and GetAxisPositionCurveTimes, the read slot of the other curve tables

name: GetAxisPositionCurveTimes
evidence: passes the axis curves to GatherAxisCurveTimes

name: EvaluateVectorKeyPositionCurve
evidence: evaluates the key list with EvaluateVectorKeyCurve, then tells the owner's slot 44

name: ReadVectorKeyPositionCurve
evidence: original assembly; slot 1 of D_002196C8 between EvaluateVectorKeyPositionCurve and GetVectorKeyPositionCurveTimes, the read slot of the other curve tables

name: GetVectorKeyPositionCurveTimes
evidence: passes the key count and keys to GetVectorKeyTimes

name: EvaluateAxisRotationCurve
evidence: evaluates the three axis curves with func_0011F6B0 into temporaries, converts them with func_00188A20 and func_001EDE38, then tells the owner's slot 45

name: GetAxisRotationCurve
evidence: returns func_0011F6B0 of the axis curves and base vector with four given words

name: ReadAxisRotationCurve
evidence: reads the axis curves, evaluates the curve at its first and last key times and sets closed to 1 when the two results differ by less than 0.01 (or there are no keys)

name: GetAxisRotationCurveKeyTimes
evidence: rotation curve kind 0 (table D_002196E8) slot 3: forwards its three per-axis weight curves to func_0011F850, which gathers their key times into the count and array out-parameters

name: EvaluateKeyedRotationCurve
evidence: rotation curve kind 1 (table D_002196F8) slot 0: evaluates its keys with func_0011F9F8 into a local buffer, converts the result into the output and state records, then calls the parent's slot 29 on them

name: GetKeyedRotationCurve
evidence: slot 1 of the keyed rotation curve table D_002196F8: returns func_0011F9F8 (EvaluateVectorKeyCurve) of its count and keys, as GetAxisRotationCurve does for the axis kind

name: ReadKeyedRotationCurve
evidence: rotation curve kind 1 slot 2: reads the keys from the stream with func_0011FA88, then sets closed to 1 when there are fewer than 2 keys or the first and last orientations differ by under 0.01

name: GetKeyedRotationCurveKeyTimes
evidence: rotation curve kind 1 slot 3: passes its count and keys to func_0011FB98 to fill the key-time count and array

name: EvaluateAxisScaleCurve
evidence: scale curve kind 0 (table D_00219718) slot 0: evaluates the three per-axis weight curves with func_0011F6B0 and writes the three results into a cleared 0x30-byte output

name: ReadAxisScaleCurve
evidence: scale curve kind 0 slot 1: reads the base vector and the three per-axis weight curves from the stream with func_0011F798

name: GetAxisScaleCurveKeyTimes
evidence: scale curve kind 0 slot 2: forwards its axis weight curves to func_0011F850 to gather their key times

name: EvaluateKeyedScaleCurve
evidence: scale curve kind 1 (table D_00219728) slot 0: evaluates its keys with func_0011F9F8 and writes the three results into a cleared 0x30-byte output

name: ReadKeyedScaleCurve
evidence: scale curve kind 1 slot 1: reads count and keys from the stream with func_0011FA88

name: GetKeyedScaleCurveKeyTimes
evidence: scale curve kind 1 slot 2: passes its count and keys to func_0011FB98 to fill the key-time count and array

name: EvaluateBlendedPositionCurve
evidence: original assembly; slot 0 of the position curve kind 2 table D_002196D8: evaluates each target's position curve at its scaled time (FindCyclicRangeIndex for a cyclic range) and sums the results by their weights, as EvaluateValueBlendCurve does for values

name: EvaluateBlendedRotationCurve
evidence: original assembly; slot 0 of the rotation curve kind 2 table D_00219708: evaluates each target's rotation at its scaled time and mixes them by their weights through BuildEulerRotationMatrix, MultiplyMatrices3x3, MatrixToAxisAngle and BuildAxisAngleMatrix

name: EvaluateAngleBlendCurve
evidence: weight curve kind 3 (table D_00219698) slot 0: evaluates each target curve at its scaled time, mixes the values by their weights as angles (func_001EA408 wraps) and sums the slopes

name: EvaluateValueBlendCurve
evidence: weight curve kind 4 (table D_002196A8) slot 0: evaluates each target curve at its scaled time and returns the weight-summed value and slope, using the owner's value at index for missing targets

name: CreatePositionCurve
evidence: allocates 0x30, 0x14 or 0x18 bytes for kind 0, 1 or 2, sets the table D_002196B8, D_002196C8 or D_002196D8 and stores the kind

name: CreateRotationCurve
evidence: allocates 0x30, 0x14 or 0x1C bytes for kind 0, 1 or 2, sets the table D_002196E8, D_002196F8 or D_00219708 and stores the kind

name: CreateScaleCurve
evidence: allocates 0x30 or 0x10 bytes for kind 0 or 1, sets the table D_00219718 or D_00219728 and stores the kind

name: CreateWeightCurve
evidence: allocates 0x10, 0x14 or 0x18 bytes for kinds 0..4, sets the tables D_00219668 ... D_002196A8 and stores the kind

name: CreatePoseSource
evidence: takes a record from the world's pool at +0x1B20, stores the given table at +0 and calls its slot 0 with the owner

name: ClonePoseSource
evidence: creates a record with the table D_00219560 for the new owner and copies the given record into it through slot 1

name: CopyPoseSource
evidence: slot 1: copies the source record's bytes (the pool's record size) over itself, then restores its own link and owner

name: InitPoseSource
evidence: slot 0 of the base: stores the owner and sets the four mode bytes at 0x10..0x13 to -1

name: ReleasePoseSource
evidence: slot 2: takes the record out of the owner's list at +0x1E0, tells the owner (slot 43), and if it was the position or orientation source gives the owner a default one, then returns the record to the pool

name: GetOwnerPosition
evidence: slot 4 of the base: returns the owner's vector at +0x190 and a zero vector, then tells the owner through its slot 40

name: GetOwnerRotation
evidence: slot 5 of the base: returns the owner's matrix at +0x1A0 and a zero vector, then tells the owner through its slot 41

name: GetOwnerValue
evidence: slot 6 of the base: returns the value at +0x8C of the owner's record at +0x224 and a slope of 0

name: GetIdentityMatrix
evidence: slot 7 of the base: copies the identity matrix D_002483D0 into the output

name: GetOwnerIndexedValue
evidence: slot 8 of the base: returns the owner's value array (+0x274) entry at the index

name: ChoosePoseSourceModes
evidence: sets the position and orientation modes from the owner's bytes at 0x2C9 and 0x2CA, or to 2 or 3 by the owner's mode words when those are -1

name: ApplyPoseSource
evidence: when it is the owner's position or orientation source and the flag or mode 2 asks, gets the position or orientation (slots 4, 5) and gives it to the owner through slots 29, 30, 32, 33

name: ComputePositionSpringAcceleration
evidence: original assembly: from a placed object's distance to a target position (+0x100) and to a target velocity (+0x150), each scaled by a + b + c (the three floats of the profiles at +0x20C and +0x210, divided by and multiplied by the distance), the second capped by 1/dt; ApplyPoseSourcePosition and func_001CC818 call it

name: ApplyPoseSourcePosition
evidence: original assembly: asks the pose source for its position (slot 4) and, by its position mode (byte 0x10), sets the owner's position at +0x100, pulls it with ComputePositionSpringAcceleration or eases it with ApproachValueWithRamp; func_00125440 calls it

name: ComputeRotationSpringAcceleration
evidence: original assembly: the rotation twin of ComputePositionSpringAcceleration: the angle between the owner's matrix at +0xD0 and the target (MultiplyMatrices3x3, MatrixToAxisAngle) scaled by the profile at +0x214; ApplyPoseSourceRotation and func_001CC818 call it

name: ApplyPoseSourceRotation
evidence: original assembly: asks the pose source for its rotation (slot 5) and, by its orientation mode (byte 0x11), sets the owner's matrix, pulls it with ComputeRotationSpringAcceleration or eases it, orthonormalising with OrthonormalizeMatrix; func_00125440 calls it

name: ApplyPoseSourceIndexedValue
evidence: reads the indexed value (slot 8) and, by mode3, stores it in the owner's value array or eases the stored one towards it with func_001EA4B8

name: GetPlacedObjectPositionAt
evidence: slot 34 of class 0x02: at time 0 returns the position at +0x100 and rate at +0x150, otherwise asks the path object at +0x1EC or returns position + rate * time

name: GetPlacedObjectRotationAt
evidence: slot 35 of class 0x02: at time 0 returns the matrix at +0xD0 and rate at +0x160, otherwise asks the path object at +0x1F0 or integrates the rate

name: SettlePoseSourceModes
evidence: turns a mode 7 of the position or the orientation into 3

name: InitSnapshotPoseSource
evidence: slot 0 of D_00219588: runs the base set-up and copies the owner's position, matrix, value, identity matrix and value array pointer into its own record

name: GetSnapshotPosition
evidence: slot 4 of D_00219588: returns its copied position and vector, then tells the owner through its slot 40

name: GetSnapshotRotation
evidence: slot 5 of D_00219588: returns its copied matrix and vector, then tells the owner through its slot 41

name: GetSnapshotValue
evidence: slot 6 of D_00219588: returns its copied value and slope from +0x80 and +0x84

name: GetSnapshotMatrix
evidence: slot 7 of D_00219588: copies the three rows of its matrix at +0x90 into the output

name: GetSnapshotIndexedValue
evidence: slot 8 of D_00219588: returns the entry of its copied value array at the index

name: InitLinkedPoseSource
evidence: slot 0 of D_002195B0: runs the base set-up and stores pointers to the owner's position, matrix, count, value array and (when its flag is set) value

name: GetLinkedPosition
evidence: slot 4 of D_002195B0: copies the vectors its pointers refer to into the outputs, then tells the owner through its slot 40

name: GetLinkedRotation
evidence: slot 5 of D_002195B0: copies the matrix and vector its pointers refer to into the outputs and calls the owner's slot 41

name: GetLinkedValue
evidence: slot 6 of D_002195B0: returns the floats its two pointers refer to

name: GetLinkedMatrix
evidence: slot 7 of D_002195B0: copies the three rows of the matrix its pointer refers to into the output

name: GetLinkedIndexedValue
evidence: slot 8 of D_002195B0: returns the entry of the array its pointer holds at the index

name: InitIdentityPoseSource
evidence: slot 0 of D_002195D8: runs the base set-up and sets its two matrices at +0x40 and +0x90 to the identity matrix D_002483D0

name: GetIdentityPosePosition
evidence: original assembly; slot 4 of InitIdentityPoseSource's table D_002195D8: the position of the source at +0x8 (its slot 4) or GetOwnerPosition, plus its own offset (vadd)

name: GetIdentityPoseRotation
evidence: original assembly; slot 5 of D_002195D8: the rotation of the source at +0x8 or GetOwnerRotation, combined with its own matrix

name: GetNextPoseSourceValue
evidence: walks the owner's list from this record to the first one whose orientation mode is not -1 (0 ends the walk) and asks it for the value (slot 6), else uses the owner's value

name: GetIdentityPoseMatrix
evidence: original assembly; slot 7 of D_002195D8: the matrix of the source at +0x8 or GetIdentityMatrix, combined with its own

name: GetIdentityPoseIndexedValue
evidence: returns 0.0; slot 8 of D_002195D8, the indexed-value slot (GetOwnerIndexedValue, GetSnapshotIndexedValue)

name: InitAimPoseSource
evidence: slot 0 of D_00219600: InitPoseSource, then 1.0 at +0x1C and 0.25 at +0x20

name: GetAimPoseRotation
evidence: original assembly; slot 5 of D_00219600: builds its rotation with func_00189C28 (as MakeScriptDirectionMatrix does) from a difference of two points scaled by a reciprocal (vdiv)

name: ReleaseTrackPoseSource
evidence: slot 2 of D_002197C0: takes itself out of the player's list at +0x44, clears the player's driven pointer if it was this record, then runs the base release

name: CopyTrackPoseSource
evidence: slot 1 of D_002197C0: runs the common copy and restores its own player pointer and the pair at +0x20

name: GetTrackPosition
evidence: slot 4 of D_002197C0: evaluates the track's position curve at the player's time (advanced by the given fraction of its speed), or falls back to the owner's position when the track has none

name: GetTrackRotation
evidence: slot 5 of D_002197C0: evaluates the track's rotation curve at the player's time, or falls back to the owner's orientation when the track has none

name: GetTrackValue
evidence: slot 6 of D_002197C0: evaluates the track's weight curve at the player's time, or falls back to the owner's value when the track has none

name: GetTrackScaleMatrix
evidence: slot 7 of D_002197C0: evaluates the track's scale curve at the player's time, or returns the identity matrix when the track has none

name: GetTrackIndexedValue
evidence: slot 8 of D_002197C0: evaluates the indexed weight curve of the track at the player's time and returns the value
